target.name: Shared app sign-in code
target.subject: Your {{APP_NAME}} sign-in code: {{CODE}}
target.htmlBody:
{{APP_INITIAL}}
{{APP_NAME}}

Your sign-in code

Use this code to finish signing in to {{APP_NAME}}. It expires in 10 minutes.

{{CODE}}

This code was requested for {{EMAIL}}. If that was not you, ignore this email - nothing changes.

Never share this code. The {{APP_NAME}} team will never ask for it.

Sent by {{FROM_NAME}} because someone asked to sign in to {{APP_NAME}} with this email. Delivered via your organisation's own mail system.

guards.create: Source content and console ownership must match; target absent or exact idempotent match. Never overwrite a different target.
guards.update: No implicit update allowed. Changed source or target requires a new reviewed preimage.
guards.rollback: Restore old caller/function before retirement. Remove only the exact created target under normal Owner authority with zero job/log references; otherwise retain unused for history. Never change the original Dek template.
